entities.name: Kálmán Kulcsár
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kálmán Kulcsár was a Hungarian politician and jurist, who served as Minister of Justice between 1988 and 1990. He was the father of the sociology of law in Hungary. He served as the last chairman of the Patriotic People's Front until 1990 and after that as Hungarian ambassador to Canada.
